card.name: Southern English place names in canal text
card.fires_on: Linking words and name starts in descriptions of southern English geography, mainly Wiltshire, Oxfordshire and Berkshire canals and towns. It fires on words like 'and', 'at', 'to' or 'Long' just before another place name.

modes.label: Linking words before a place
modes.description: A small word such as and, at, in or to sits right before the next English town or county name.

modes.description: The first piece of a town or county name in a list of canal stops.
modes.example: There were also branches to Chippenham, Calne,<< Long>>cot (near Shrivenham) and

card.writes: It seems to push toward place-name pieces and away from Chinese place names and Tennessee, so the effect is weak and mixed.
